params.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic horror film still, first-person point of view looking down a narrow hallway of a rotting old wooden farmhouse at night, peeling floral wallpaper, warped floorboards. The only light is a single police flashlight beam from the viewer. Standing at the far end of the hallway is an elderly woman apparition who is impossibly tall, close to nine feet, and severely emaciated, with unnaturally elongated thin arms that hang past her knees, very long thin legs, and long bony fingers. Long stringy grayish-blonde hair hangs down over her face and completely hides the right half of her face; on her left side the hair parts to show one enormous round bulging eye with no eyelid, wet and glassy with a pale washed-out iris, staring straight at the viewer. Grey papery mottled skin with age spots, sunken cheeks, thin neck. She wears a stained threadbare old-fashioned long cotton nightgown. She is hunched forward because she is too tall for the ceiling, her head tilted sideways just under the ceiling, arms hanging limp. Deep black shadows, faint dust in the beam, muted desaturated colors, 35mm, shallow grain, extremely unsettling, no text.
